messages.subject: Webinar: Restructuring Plans & the creditor duty after Sequana - 5 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

You are invited to LexBridge Training's CPD webinar, 'Restructuring Plans and the creditor duty after BTI v Sequana', on 5 February at 1pm (1 CPD hour). Our panel will cover recent Part 26A case law and directors' duties in distressed situations.

Registration is free for in-house and private practice lawyers. Click below to reserve your place.

Kind regards,
Jordan Cole
LexBridge Training
